records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Ocean Transportation revenue increased $383.4 million, or 68.4 percent, during the three months ended March 31, 2022, compared with the three months ended March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Ocean Transportation: The Company’s container volume in the Hawaii service in the first quarter 2022 was 0.6 percent lower year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease was primarily due to lower eastbound volume.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in interest expense for the three months ended March 31, 2022, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2021, was due to lower outstanding debt during the period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Logistics: In the first quarter 2022, operating income for the Company’s Logistics segment was $16.4 million, or $10.3 million higher compared to the level achieved in the first quarter 2021.
